learning_outcomes.text: Understand basic terms, units, principles, methods and devices for measurement of geometrical units, mass, and mechanical units, temperature and thermal units, pressure, hydro-static and hydro-dynamic units, noise and vibrations, and other physical and mechanical units.
Understand the main reasons for faults when measuring the above-mentioned units and the methods for improving the accuracy of measurement.
Acquire practical skills for using measurement devices and equipment.

assessment_rules: The course finishes with a written exam, checking students’ creative and practical thinking, applied in solving specific cases and problems. The final mark is formed after an oral interview (if needed).
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
